sandboxHelperDiscovery.note: recorded as the discovery reason/source only; NOT a browser-success claim

chromium.chromeSandboxInternals: chrome://sandbox renders a two-cell table (#sandbox-status) with rows Layer 1 Sandbox (Namespace/SUID/None), PID namespaces, Network namespaces, Seccomp-BPF sandbox, Seccomp-BPF sandbox supports TSYNC (Yes/No); #evaluation holds the verdict; see chromium 155.0.8059.12 chrome/browser/resources/sandbox_internals/sandbox_internals.{ts,html}

firstBuildFailure.stage: apt dependency resolution (failed BEFORE any npm/browser/runtime execution)

firstBuildFailure.error: poppler-utils : Depends: libpoppler126 (= 22.12.0-2+deb12u2) but 22.12.0-2+deb12u3 is to be installed
firstBuildFailure.cause: bookworm-security updates libpoppler126 to 22.12.0-2+deb12u3; poppler-utils was pinned to the older main version deb12u2, whose exact dependency then conflicted
firstBuildFailure.fix: pin poppler-utils to the security-updated 22.12.0-2+deb12u3 (libpoppler126 resolves to the matching deb12u3); do not downgrade the security library
firstBuildFailure.coherenceScan: all other pinned packages' exact-version (=) Dependencies resolve to the snapshot versions (python3->libpython3-stdlib, python3-venv->python3, libreoffice-impress->libreoffice-core/libreoffice-draw); no other mismatch found. libnss3/libexpat1/ca-certificates were left at their resolved versions (no exact-dependency conflict; changing them would be unrelated scope)
